name: IT Career Interest Profiler
description: 36 statements written by the team, based on Holland's RIASEC interest types. Each item measures one RIASEC type (6 per type); 20 items also point to one of the 5 IT areas (4 per area).

scoring.riasec: sum of the 6 items per type, 6-30; percent = (total - 6) / 24 x 100
scoring.area_items: mean of the 4 items per IT area; score = (mean - 1) / 4 x 100
scoring.role_interest: Pearson correlation between the six RIASEC totals and the role's O*NET interest scores, mapped from -1..1 to 0..100
scoring.preference: 0.6 x area items + 0.4 x mean role interest of the area's roles (team choice)

source_name: Team-written items; RIASEC types from O*NET Career Interest Types
attribution: Questions written by the team, based on Holland's RIASEC types as used by O*NET (USDOL/ETA). Not an official O*NET instrument.
